correctness.rationale: For each undirected 16-vertex circulant step set (1,2,3,8) and (1,4,7,8), exact face enumeration yields (f0,f1,f2)=(16,64,64). The inspected independent reproducer constructs 63 disjoint acyclic Hasse pairs (144 cells, 320 arrows), leaving critical cells (1,1,16). Its actual signed 49-by-64 triangle presentation has Smith invariant factors 1 repeated 48, so H1 is Z, and the sixteen Morse 2-cell attaching degrees into the one-cell circle all vanish. Thus the claimed integral homotopy wedge follows. Distinct edge-common-neighbor distributions prove graph nonisomorphism. No extrapolation beyond the two named graphs.
